thread:
ana: Quick sync  product is adding `retention_period_days` to exports. Need a docs snippet (curl + js), a short migration note for older `ttl_days`, and a support runbook.
tom: I can draft the snippets. Confirm endpoint and constraints?
ana: Endpoint: POST /v1/exports. Field: `retention_period_days` int, allowed 7-3650. Server will accept legacy `ttl_days` for 60 days and return a deprecation header.
tom: Draft curl: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/exports \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name":"audit-jan","retention_period_days":90,"scope":"organization"}'
```

JS SDK draft:```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood(process.env.REDWOOD_KEY);
await client.exports.create({ name: 'audit-jan', retention_period_days: 90, scope: 'organization' });
```
olivia: Legal: use 'retention period' when customer-facing and add link to DPA. Add SOC2 note: "Export retention is controlled by customer admins; Redwood does not use exported audit data for telemetry."
ana: Migration note I'll add: "Exports created before 2026-05-01 will remain unchanged. Admins may update `retention_period_days` to opt into the new expiry window."
tom: Add an example showing old param mapping and response header: request with `ttl_days` accepted, response contains `X-Deprecation: ttl_days; max-age=5184000` (60d).
support: We'll prepare outreach copy and a short admin runbook (how to update exports and how opt-ins are handled). Tagging support-team.
docs-bot: PR opened by ana  reviewers: olivia, tom. Preview: https://deploy-preview-600--docs.redwood.com
ana: Timeline: get legal sign-off today, merge to staging tomorrow, customer email next Tue. Thanks! :pray:
